# edgeos_config (Resource)

Manage any EdgeOS config node by path. Use it for settings that have no dedicated resource.

Set exactly one of:

- `value` for a leaf with one value (`system time-zone`),
- `values` for a multi-valued leaf (`system name-server`), the order is kept,
- `tree` for a whole subtree as JSON, in the same shape the EdgeOS API uses: objects for nodes, strings for values, lists of strings for multi-valued leaves and `null` for valueless nodes,
- none of them to only make sure a valueless node or empty tag exists (`service unms`).

With `tree` the resource owns the whole subtree: children added outside Terraform show up as drift and are removed on the next apply. Destroying the resource deletes the node.

The node must not exist yet when the resource is created; import existing nodes instead. Passwords (`plaintext-password`) cannot be managed with `tree`, because EdgeOS replaces them with a hash on commit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A single value.
resource "edgeos_config" "dns_cache" {
  path  = ["service", "dns", "forwarding", "cache-size"]
  value = "1000"
}

# A multi-valued leaf; the order is kept.
resource "edgeos_config" "dns_listen" {
  path   = ["service", "dns", "forwarding", "listen-on"]
  values = ["switch0", "eth1.20"]
}

# A valueless node: without value, values or tree the resource only makes
# sure the node exists. This one switches off port eth4.
resource "edgeos_config" "eth4_disabled" {
  path = ["interfaces", "ethernet", "eth4", "disable"]
}

# A whole subtree. Values are strings, lists of strings or null.
resource "edgeos_config" "nightly_backup" {
  path = ["system", "task-scheduler", "task", "nightly-backup"]
  tree = jsonencode({
    crontab-spec = "30 3 * * *"
    executable = {
      path      = "/config/scripts/backup.sh"
      arguments = "--quiet"
    }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (List of String) Node names from the root, for example `["service", "dns", "forwarding", "cache-size"]`. Changing it creates a new resource.

### Optional

- `tree` (String) The subtree below `path` as JSON, usually written with `jsonencode()`. Values must be strings, lists of strings or `null`; numbers and booleans are rejected because EdgeOS stores everything as text.
- `value` (String) Value of a single-valued leaf.
- `values` (List of String) Values of a multi-valued leaf, in order.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path in CLI form, such as `system time-zone`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the config path as the EdgeOS CLI shows it.
terraform import edgeos_config.dns_cache 'service dns forwarding cache-size'
```
